run_relax_job: run a geometry optimization job on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator and optimization flags
run_single_point_job: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator
run_conformers: run geometry optimizations on molecular conformers organized by molecule families using an ASE calculator
run_protonation: run protonation state energy and geometry calculations for molecules using an ASE calculator
run_ieea: run unoptimized ionization energy and electron affinity calculations on structures at different charge states
